limits: Static snapshot and public signature sidecars are replaceable evidence caches
Verification independently fetches selected RPC state and checks code hashes and all co-signatures
Publishing new rounds or signatures requires regenerating the bundle
Private participation, trustee and operator services remain local; no institutional custody claimed
Hosting and physical-phone verification are performed by the project owner
evidenceRefresh: Retained original pinned dossiers; source/arithmetic/signatures rechecked offline. This UI refresh sends no transaction and makes no new online-reproduction claim.
